title: TOOL-INVENTORY-MS0
brief: Adopt 8 external MCP servers as exposure-surfaces over existing PRISM engines. 8 of 18 surveyed servers overlap with existing PRISM functionality — adopt = wrap our engine as that server's tool, NOT pull in their implementation. Plus 1 registry unit + 1 wiring unit = 10. Lane-F owns this — no critical-path blockers, parallel-safe across all 10 sub-units (one-shot expose-and-test per server).
